_comment: The security checks, and where each one runs. Shift-left means the same control runs as early as it can, and again later where nobody can switch it off.

Stages: bob = Bob's hook, on every write before it lands (built-in checks only; IDE tools such as Bob's own scans or IBM Concert Secure Coder sit here too) · commit = the git pre-commit hook, on what is staged · scan = /sdd-scan before any testing, and the pipeline's scan stage, on all production code · pipeline = the pipeline only (slow or licensed tools).

scanner: who gives the verdict at /sdd-scan and in the pipeline's scan stage. 'builtin' = the checks below (no server, ideal for labs); 'sonarqube' = SonarQube's quality gate plus dependency CVEs (sdd/docs/SONARQUBE.md); the checks below still run alongside it.

Plug in your organisation's own tools as 'command' checks: the command gets the files to check in {files}; exit code 0 passes, anything else is a finding. An enabled tool that is not installed fails the check (fail closed), so switching a tool on is a real decision.
Governance file: change it in a chore(SDD) commit that code owners review. node sdd/scripts/checks.mjs --validate runs in every pipeline; the secrets check cannot be switched off or downgraded.
node sdd/scripts/checks.mjs --list shows what runs where. sdd/docs/CHECKS.md maps each stage to tools, including the IBM portfolio.

checks.title: No secrets in code
checks.note: Also locked on as commit rule G10 and as the pipeline's secrets stage.

checks.title: Risky code patterns: SQL built from strings, TLS checks switched off, eval, weak hashes, Math.random for secret values
Dependency rules: nothing on the deny-list; exact versions preferred
checks.note: Deny-list in sdd/governance/dependency-denylist.json. Unpinned versions are a warning, not a block.

checks.title: IBM detect-secrets (open source): deterministic secret scanning at commit and on all code, with an audited baseline
checks.install: pip install --upgrade "git+https://github.com/ibm/detect-secrets.git@master#egg=detect-secrets" && detect-secrets scan --update .secrets.baseline && detect-secrets audit .secrets.baseline

checks.title: HashiCorp Vault Radar (IBM): secret scanning tied to your HashiCorp Vault
IBM Bob Shell (bob run) review of the change, in the read-only 🔎 SDD PR Reviewer mode (advisory: Bob flags, the checks and people decide)

run.command: bob run --mode sdd-pr-reviewer --trust --accept-license --disable-mcp --disable-subagents --max-turns 30 --max-cost 2 --format json "Review the changes on this branch against their specs. List only real problems, with file and line. If there are none, answer exactly NO FINDINGS." > .scannerwork/bob-review.json; grep -q 'NO FINDINGS' .scannerwork/bob-review.json
